description: Records that use extensions this schema does not declare, and which MUST still validate. The README claims that unknown category slugs stay protocol-valid and that new promotion mechanisms and targets arrive as additive union members; those claims are load-bearing for the whole boundary design, so they are tested rather than asserted. Phase 6 relaxes the 'declared union members only' rule that phase 3 applies to our own fixtures, because tolerating undeclared members is precisely what is under test here.

expectAccepted.unknown-category-slug.json: an app-registered category outside the 21 advisory slugs
expectAccepted.unknown-promotion-mechanism.json: a percentage-discount mechanism added without a schema change
expectAccepted.unknown-promotion-target.json: a collection target added without a schema change
expectAccepted.unknown-availability.json: a backorder state added without a schema change
